title: The Row of Ancestors

steps.prompt: 5 figures stand in a row of numbered pews, numbered 1 to 5 from the left: the Butler, the Cook, the Doctor, the Duke, the Heir. Use the clues, then answer: who stands in pew number 4? (Just the title, like Baron.)
clues: The Heir is in an even-numbered pew.
The Butler is at one of the two ends of the row.
The Butler is somewhere to the left of the Duke.
The Duke is in an odd-numbered pew.
Exactly 0 pews separate the Duke from the Doctor.
The Doctor is somewhere between the Heir and the Duke.

reveal_text: The planchette slides to a number and stops: 5.
